queryOutcomes: Separate English and French discovery queries are recorded in city-1268-tahoua.json. They identified the official DGI Tahoua conservation-office communiqué, DGI strategic plan, and national geospatial-authority metadata.

No public viewer JavaScript/configuration or anonymous parcel API was identified.
